rationale: The original thesis remains intact as IESC trades below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($158.75) and well below session VWAP ($165.38), while the broader market continues to weaken (SPY down -2.53%). Recent bounce attempts over the last five 1-minute candles occurred on rapidly declining volume (dropping from 7,946 to under 410 shares) and failed to sustain prices above the 9-EMA. With 100 minutes remaining in the session and the spread currently widened to 51.7 bps, holding for continuation toward the $154.50 target is favored over exiting prematurely into a wide spread.
